subject: UniProtKB:Q9HXD4
description: Nitrate/nitrite transport contribution to the complete pathway; this edge does not assign strict 1:1 antiport or isolated exact transport stoichiometry. NarK2 has the dominant phenotype and NarK1 a smaller contribution in the tested PAO1 conditions.

evidence.source_assertion: This current UniProtKB unreviewed (TrEMBL) entry assigns Q9HXD4 to taxon 208964, narK2 / PA3876, with a 468-residue sequence. It does not establish sequence identity to every historical preparation.
PAO1 narK1 deletion only slightly affected anaerobic growth, while narK2 and double deletion were severely compromised; all mutants retained nitrate-reductase activity.
The authors explicitly leave antiport versus uniport experimentally unresolved.
